name: Reconcile hosted relay fleet
description: Operator-side brain of the shared relay fleet: reconciles finished shard lifecycle jobs into slot statuses, dispatches flagged work as server_manager jobs (relay_add_tenant / relay_set_domains / relay_remove_tenant), and re-checks each active slot's entitlement with the grace-window suspension. Runs every cron pass (every_run); no-op unless this deployment runs the fleet service.
